title: Section 109 BSA — Fact especially within knowledge

content.overview: Section 109 puts the burden of a fact especially within one person's knowledge on that person. It is the successor of Evidence Act 106.
content.study: The existing topic bsa-s-106 is a different BSA section (particular fact). Use 109 for the classic last-seen / special-knowledge argument. It does not lift the prosecution's primary burden under 104.
